{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction: proportion of converted orders among loyal customers
fraction_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].mean()

# Print the result
print(fraction_converted)"}
